name: Nyerere National Park
intro: Nyerere National Park is Tanzania’s largest and one of Africa’s most spectacular wilderness areas, offering an authentic safari experience far from the crowds. Located in the southern circuit, the park was formerly part of the Selous Game Reserve and spans vast savannahs, woodlands, wetlands, rivers, and lakes. The mighty Rufiji River flows through the park, sustaining abundant wildlife and creating dramatic landscapes that are perfect for exploration, photography, and nature appreciation.

The park is renowned for its diverse and abundant wildlife, including elephants, lions, leopards, buffaloes, giraffes, hippos, crocodiles, and the rare African wild dog. Its remote location and vast, open spaces allow for uninterrupted wildlife encounters, making every safari a memorable adventure. Visitors can enjoy classic game drives, walking safaris, and boat safaris along the Rufiji River, all set within a pristine, largely untouched ecosystem. With its combination of wilderness, biodiversity, and fewer visitors, Nyerere National Park offers an exclusive and adventurous African safari experience.
